name: webcraft-local-builder
description: A local-first visual website builder powered by Payload CMS and PostgreSQL.

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n cms,builder -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @webcraft/cms dev" "pnpm --filter @webcraft/builder dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @webcraft/core build && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @webcraft/cms build && pnpm --filter @webcraft/builder build
scripts.build:packaged: pnpm --filter @webcraft/core build && pnpm --filter @webcraft/cms build && pnpm --filter @webcraft/builder build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @webcraft/core test && pnpm --filter @webcraft/builder test && pnpm test:runtime
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @webcraft/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @webcraft/cms typecheck && pnpm --filter @webcraft/builder typecheck
